prompts.title: Blue Elegance
prompts.prompt: Using the attached reference photo, keep the person's face, hairstyle, skin tone and features exactly the same. Dress the person in an elegant royal-blue traditional shalwar kameez with matching trousers, premium textured fabric, and a perfectly tailored fit. Place the person standing confidently in a beautiful traditional courtyard with carved wooden doors, warm stone walls, and decorative plants. Use soft golden-hour sunlight with gentle shadows and natural highlights. Capture the portrait with an 85mm lens at f/1.8, maintaining sharp facial details and a beautifully blurred background. Apply rich blue tones, warm cinematic color grading, and a luxurious, peaceful fashion mood. Photorealistic, vertical 4:5, no text, no watermark, no logos.
